tier-05/views/top.description: View from high overhead looking directly down on crown, wings and barrel. Body foreshortened under top. Not an upright front view.
tier-05/views/top.upgrade_description: Galactic Starburst: majestic full wings, delicate star halo/crown, prismatic crystal clusters around base and star-framed glowing muzzle, ornate gold base; preserve the original face and STAR-SHAPED barrel.
tier-05/views/top.prompt: Precise camera correction for ONE Starburst Cannon Tier 5 top-view sprite. Image1 is the APPROVED ORIGINAL OVERHEAD CAMERA AND ANATOMY: camera sees the plush crown/top of head, clouds, barrel and wings, NOT its face. Image2 is the approved upgraded tier's ornament reference. Recreate image1 camera and top silhouette while adding ALL tier decorations from image2. Galactic Starburst: majestic full wings, delicate star halo/crown, prismatic crystal clusters around base and star-framed glowing muzzle, ornate gold base; preserve the original face and STAR-SHAPED barrel. CRITICAL: ABSOLUTELY NO EYES, NO MOUTH, NO CHEEKS, NO FACE AT LOWER EDGE OR ANYWHERE. Those front surfaces are hidden below the overhead silhouette. The entire visible central body is uninterrupted lavender plush fur/cloud swirls. Keep the gold STAR-SHAPED barrel opening and galaxy core visible from above, never make it round. Preserve upgraded wings, crowns/halo, ribbons and crystals as appropriate. Full sprite centered, no clipping of top halo or wings. Genuine transparent background, no panel, floor, text, front view or extra character.
